critic.fix_suggestion: Modify the 'Main deck window row' geometry by replacing the uniform dot array with a parametric distribution. Define three distinct zones along the fuselage length: (1) Cockpit/Nose area with 20% wider spacing, (2) Main Cabin doors with 50% wider gaps to accommodate door frames, and (3) Rear Fuselage with standard 10cm intervals. Implement this by offsetting the window primitive positions from the centerline based on a variable 'gap_factor' mapped to the fuselage length coordinate.
